cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(cidu_storage LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SNAPPY_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SNAPPY_BUILD_BENCHMARKS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SNAPPY_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Keep upstream sources unchanged while allowing their pre-3.5 policy declaration
# to configure on CMake 4. See CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM in the CMake manual.
if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 4.0)
  set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
endif()
add_subdirectory(snappy-1.2.1)
set(HAVE_SNAPPY ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HAVE_CRC32C OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HAVE_TCMALLOC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEVELDB_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEVELDB_BUILD_BENCHMARKS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEVELDB_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(leveldb-1.23)
target_include_directories(leveldb PRIVATE snappy-1.2.1 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/snappy-1.2.1)
